items.title: Angola Talking Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: The name 'Hog Man' is a nickname given to the interviewee by others ('they named me the Hog Man'), not a separate person.

ctx.x: No, sir, never did none. None of the rest. Of course, I play piano a little bit, but I never did play enough to do no good.
Harmonica? No, sir, never did none. Pazoo. Okay. Just a pazoo. Just a pazoo. Okay. How come they call you Hog Man?

Well... That was kind of a short name that they gave me. They was, uh... I always believed that I was a hog doctor and I... So I started off doctoring on hogs, and every time Dad would get a bunch of pigs and they'd leave home, I'd give a hog doctor. So I messed around, I think I killed about half of them, and they named me the Hog Man behind. Ha, ha, ha, ha, ha, ha, ha. I always figured that the one needed operating on.
